_about: What RoccobotOS takes from elsewhere, at which version, and where its new versions appear. check-dependencies.py of roccobot.github.io (.memo/scripts), run from this repo's root, compares the version in use (vendor/package.json, the one place it is written) with the latest published on npm; a newer one is read for what is worth bringing in before it is taken (Roccobot.md, 'Le dipendenze si seguono'). A new Prism comes in as files: npm pack prismjs@<version>, then the same five files of the package replace those in vendor/prism.

dependencies.name: Prism (core)
dependencies.into: vendor/prism/components/prism-core.min.js, loaded with defer by index.html: it wraps the code blocks and runs the plugins (no block uses a language Prism colours, so the core alone is enough)
dependencies.stale_accepted: 2026-11-13, Rocco's choice Prism-01: 1.30.0, the latest release, as files of the repo; the page uses the core and two plugins without any highlighting, so a quiet line costs nothing here; read again at every dependency round

dependencies.name: Prism Toolbar plugin
dependencies.into: vendor/prism/plugins/toolbar/prism-toolbar.min.js and prism-toolbar.min.css: the bar that holds the copy button of every code block
